job.title: Senior Network Engineer
job.description:
Senior Network Engineer


Salary: Up to £65,000 DOE + separate on-call allowance + paid callout payments

Location: Basildon, Essex – Hybrid, with occasional customer site and data centre visits


We are recruiting for an experienced Senior Network Engineer to join an established UK Managed Service Provider (MSP) that operates its own ISP and datacentre infrastructure, as well as delivering complex managed network services to enterprise and Critical National Infrastructure (CNI) customers.


This is a hands-on senior technical role where you will become a key technical authority across the network environment, working alongside an experienced Network and ISP Engineering team.

You will be responsible for the design, installation, migration and ongoing support of both internal service-provider and datacentre networks, as well as managed customer estates. The role offers excellent technical variety, with Cisco and Fortinet technologies at its core and a strong service-provider routing element built around BGP.


Key responsibilities:


• Take ownership of network installation and migration projects from start to finish

• Work closely with the Network Manager, Account Managers and customers to deliver projects successfully

• Maintain and develop the ISP and datacentre network, including core routing, peering, transit and edge connectivity

• Configure, manage and troubleshoot multi-customer firewall environments using FortiGate, FortiManager and Sophos XG

• Configure and support Cisco Nexus datacentre and ASR edge/service-provider platforms

• Configure and troubleshoot BGP, including peering and route policies

• Maintain and develop network monitoring and alerting systems

• Provide technical support across customer and internal network environments

• Participate in the 24/7 out-of-hours on-call rota, with a separate on-call allowance and paid callout payments

• Attend customer sites and datacentres for installations, migrations and technical support when required

The ideal candidate will have:

• Strong senior-level network engineering experience within an MSP, ISP or service-provider environment

• Extensive hands-on BGP experience, including design, peering, route policy and production troubleshooting

• Strong Cisco routing and switching experience, particularly Cisco Nexus and ASR

• Excellent Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking knowledge, including VLANs, trunking, STP, EIGRP and network redundancy/HA

• Datacentre networking experience, including resilient network design and structured cabling

• Strong Fortinet experience, particularly FortiGate and FortiManager

• Experience with firewalling at scale, NAT, IPS, web and antivirus filtering, IPSec site-to-site VPNs and SSL VPNs

• Understanding of internet connectivity including FTTC, FTTP and leased lines, together with transit and peering concepts

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills

• Excellent customer-facing communication skills

• Full UK driving licence

Desirable experience and qualifications:

• CCNP or equivalent

• Fortinet NSE/FCP certification

• HPE Aruba, Cisco Meraki or Ubiquiti UniFi

• Sophos or Cisco ASA/Firepower

• Windows Server knowledge

• Hyper-V or VMware

• Experience working within CNI, datacentre or other high-availability environments


We are looking for someone who is dependable, calm under pressure and methodical when troubleshooting. You will need to be comfortable working independently, taking ownership of issues and projects through to completion, while also being a strong team player with a customer-focused approach.


This is an excellent opportunity for a Senior Network Engineer looking for a technically challenging role with exposure to ISP, datacentre, MSP and enterprise environments. You will have the opportunity to work on complex infrastructure, take ownership of significant network projects and continue developing your technical expertise across multiple technologies.


Salary is up to £65,000 depending on experience, with a separate on-call allowance and paid callout payments in addition to the basic salary.


WE Talent acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment.


We are committed to creating inclusive recruitment processes and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We believe diverse teams bring broader perspectives, stronger ideas and better outcomes, and we encourage applications from anyone who meets the key requirements of the role.

job.title: HR Manager
job.description:
Human Resources Manager – Trainees

£65,000 | London | Permanent


We are working with a well-established and highly regarded law firm who are looking to appoint a Human Resources Manager to take ownership of their Trainee Solicitor programme and wider early careers activity.


This is a specialist HR role with a strong focus on legal trainees, making previous experience within a law firm and direct experience managing the trainee lifecycle essential.


You will work closely with senior HR colleagues, the Training Principal, Recruitment and senior stakeholders across the firm to ensure trainees receive a well-managed, supportive and high-quality experience from recruitment through to qualification.


The Role

This is a varied role covering the full trainee journey, including:

  • Managing and developing the firm's Trainee Solicitor programme from recruitment through to qualification.
  • Acting as a key point of contact for trainees throughout their training contracts.
  • Supporting trainee recruitment, including assessment centres, interviews, offers and onboarding.
  • Managing trainee inductions, mentor and buddy programmes and ongoing engagement.
  • Coordinating seat rotations, working closely with trainees, supervisors and Heads of Department.
  • Supporting performance management, appraisals, employee relations, absence and wellbeing matters.
  • Providing guidance to supervisors and managers on the effective management and development of trainees.
  • Managing the qualification and NQ recruitment process, ensuring a smooth transition from trainee to newly qualified solicitor.
  • Supporting trainees through the SQE route, including study and examination leave and liaising with relevant course providers.
  • Leading the firm's Vacation Scheme and supporting the development of the future talent pipeline.
  • Using trainee feedback, recruitment data and market insight to identify opportunities to improve the programme.

About You

We are looking for an experienced HR professional who understands the legal trainee environment and has genuinely managed or supported trainees through their career journey.

You will ideally have:

  • A minimum of 3 years' HR experience within a law firm or legal environment.
  • Proven experience working directly with legal trainees, including onboarding, seat rotations, appraisals, performance management and qualification.
  • A good understanding of the Training Contract and SQE routes.
  • Experience supporting or delivering trainee recruitment, assessment centres and/or Vacation Schemes.
  • Strong knowledge of HR best practice and the ability to provide confident advice to managers and employees.
  • CIPD Level 5 or 7 qualification would be highly desirable, although this is not essential.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to work with trainees, Partners, Heads of Department and senior HR stakeholders.
  • A highly organised and proactive approach, with excellent attention to detail.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced professional services environment.

 

What's on Offer?

  • £65,000 salary
  • Private medical insurance
  • Pension scheme

  • Regular company-wide events and team social activities
  • Excellent career development and progression opportunities
  • Opportunity to join a well-established and respected law firm
  • A specialist role with significant ownership of the firm's trainee and early careers programme
  • The opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders and influence the development of the firm's future legal talent

If you have previous HR experience within a law firm and have a strong background working with legal trainees, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Compliance Administrator
job.description:
WE Talent are working with a busy, dynamic City of London organisation within the legal and regulatory sector seeking an experienced Compliance Administrator (Vetting & Regulatory Screening) to join their team.


This is an excellent opportunity for a candidate with a background in compliance, governance, regulatory operations or business screening to join a fast-paced, detail-driven environment.


The role focuses on statutory-style vetting and regulatory screening of businesses, including KYC checks, application processing, and eligibility assessments.


You will manage your own caseload, handle complex enquiries, and support structured decision-making processes within a regulated framework.


This is a varied, autonomous role requiring strong attention to detail, the ability to manage a high-volume workload, and confidence working within defined processes.


What you’ll be doing


As a key member of the team, your responsibilities will include:


  • Processing incoming telephone and email enquiries relating to registration, training, education, licensing, and compliance matters
  • Managing a personal caseload of applications, amendments, and regulatory screening/vetting cases
  • Carrying out a variety of screening checks, including KYC (Know Your Client), using multiple systems and databases
  • Assessing and processing applications in line with statutory and regulatory requirements
  • Handling general enquiries and providing clear, accurate guidance to applicants and stakeholders
  • Supporting adjudication panel activity when required, including preparation of case information
  • Supporting compliance and regulatory projects alongside core caseload responsibilities
  • Assisting with the coordination and administration of meetings and stakeholder interactions where needed (kept light and supportive rather than core focus)
  • Working closely with internal teams to ensure accurate, consistent and timely processing of cases

Who we’re looking for


We’re seeking an experienced, proactive compliance or regulatory professional who is comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment with a complex and varied workload.


Essential experience and skills:


  • Experience in compliance, governance, regulatory operations, audit, business screening / vetting, or similar structured decision-making environments
  • Strong experience managing a high-volume caseload with accuracy and autonomy
  • Experience carrying out KYC and screening checks across multiple systems
  • Ability to assess information, follow regulatory processes, and work within defined frameworks
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including handling formal correspondence
  • Excellent attention to detail with a methodical, process-driven approach
  • Ability to work at pace in a complex and changing environment
  • Confident handling sensitive information with discretion and professionalism
  • Strong IT skills (Outlook, Word, Excel – intermediate), experience with case management systems advantageous
  • Understanding of compliance principles, data protection, and confidentiality requirements
  • Background in regulated environments involving statutory or quasi-statutory screening or decision-making highly beneficial

What’s on offer


  • 30 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Vitality healthcare scheme
  • Auto enrolment pension
  • Hybrid working option after training
  • 35-hour week
  • Wellness room and games room

This role is perfect for someone who enjoys variety, autonomy, and a busy, high-responsibility environment, with opportunities to work across both routine processes and project-based initiatives.


If you are confident, organised, and thrive in a busy, fast-moving role – apply now!

Suitable for: Compliance Administrators (business rather than personal), Compliance Officers, Governance Professionals, Quality Assurance Specialists, Case Handlers

job.title: Supply Chain Coordinator
job.description:
We are seeking an organised and detail-oriented Supply Chain Coordinator to join a fast-paced and growing business. This is a key position within the operations team, responsible for ensuring the smooth and efficient flow of goods across an international supply chain. You will play an integral role in supporting the delivery of products to customers, maintaining high standards of accuracy, organisation, and service.


In this role, you will take ownership of the purchase order lifecycle, from creation through to delivery, reconciliation, and post-delivery administration. You will liaise closely with suppliers to ensure orders are fulfilled within agreed timelines, while proactively tracking shipments and maintaining accurate estimated times of arrival. You will be responsible for ensuring all order and shipment data is accurately recorded and maintained across internal systems, supporting both operational efficiency and reporting requirements.


You will work collaboratively with internal teams including sales, warehouse, and finance, acting as a key point of coordination to ensure stock is allocated correctly and orders are delivered as planned. The role also involves supporting stock management processes, maintaining operational trackers, and assisting with reporting on incoming stock and supply chain performance. Where issues arise, you will take a proactive approach to problem-solving, identifying risks, communicating effectively with stakeholders, and ensuring timely resolution to minimise disruption.


The successful candidate will have previous experience within a supply chain, logistics, or administrative role and will be confident working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift. Strong organisational skills and a high level of attention to detail are essential, along with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining accuracy. You will be a strong communicator, capable of building effective working relationships both internally and externally, and confident using Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.


This is an excellent opportunity to join a dynamic and growing organisation that values teamwork, efficiency, and continuous improvement. The role offers a supportive working environment along with genuine opportunities for development and progression for the right individual.


Apply now or get in touch for more information.
